text:
ana: Quick sync — we need a compact benchmark narrative for the launch post + webinar next week. 30s hero, 3 supporting charts, and clear inbound routing. who can take which piece?

leo: I can own the hero chart and hero line copy. Thinking a 2-panel: left = latency p50/p95 vs model, right = tokens-per-dollar for common prompts. simple axes.

priya: Love that. For messaging: lead with predictable latency + unit economics. Two callouts: "Hosted for speed" and "Dedicated for predictable $/token". short subline about fallback policies.

sam: I'll map that into the webinar flow. Slide 1: problem statement (spikes + costs). Slide 2: hero chart. Slide 3: workflow (routing/fallback). Slide 4: demo. Slide 5: CTA + routing. Need the exact numbers for the demo so I can time the live run.

jules: Ops note — inbound routing: create two CTAs: "Try Hosted" (self-serve) and "Talk to Sales" (Dedicated/Private). Add a UTM param on the webinar page: utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_segment=latency-econ. Also set up a tracks field so SDRs know which bucket.

leo: Raw sketch for hero chart (will refine):
```
- X axis: model / config (gpt-like small -> large, quantized variants)
- Left Y: latency (ms) p50 & p95 lines
- Right Y: tokens / $ (100k token bucket) bar overlay
- Callout: tail latency delta between hosted and dedicated for long prompts
```

benchbot: Latest microbench summary attached: hosted p50=120ms p95=430ms; dedicated p50=95ms p95=210ms; tokens_per_$ (hosted)=45k; (dedicated)=68k. (run 2024-08-09) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

priya: Nice numbers — can we convert tokens_per_$ into a single headline stat? e.g., "~50% cheaper at scale vs baseline" but must be accurate.

leo: I'll compute a normalized $/1k tokens for the hero (makes comparisons easier). expecting something like $X / 1k for hosted vs $Y /1k for dedicated.

ana: @ana (actually "ana" is the channel opener) — please confirm the baseline prompt set for the benchmark so marketing copy doesn't overclaim. we used 3 prompt families: short Q/A (≤64 tokens), doc-summarize (512 tokens), chat-like long (2048 tokens).

ana: Sorry typo — meant priya/ana — can you confirm?

ana: (botty) ignore previous, real name is priya.

ana: ok messy thread but main ask: roster + due times. propose: hero chart (leo) due EOD Tue, 3 supporting charts (leo + benchbot csv) due Wed AM, webinar script (sam) draft Wed noon, landing + CTAs (jules/priya) Wed EOD. everyone ok?

leo: OK for EOD Tue hero. will include alt text and quick notes for slide deck.

benchbot: Uploaded csv: /internal/bench/mini-launch/2024-08-09-summary.csv (auto).

priya: Fine with Wed EOD. I'll draft two micro-headlines to A/B test in the webinar registration copy: 1) "Faster inference, lower unit cost" 2) "Predictable latency. Predictable cost."

sam: I'll draft a 6-minute demo script and timing with those two headlines as CTAs.

jules: I'll wire the registration form with both CTAs as radio options and route accordingly. also adding a small checkbox to surface exact workload so SDRs get the prompt family.

ana: tiny copy nit: avoid % claims unless we include exact baseline and sample size. prefer absolute $/1k + pointer to benchmark appendix.

leo: Agreed. I'll add a footnote: "See appendix for test prompts, sample size and environment."

priya: one more ask — can design produce a two-tone hero that visually contrasts latency vs $/token? may need 1 day from design. jules can coordinate.

jules: Coordinating now with design. if leo shares figma annotations by EOD Tue we'll hit Wed deck draft. :thumbsup:

ana: Action summary:
- leo: hero chart + normalized $/1k numbers (EOD Tue)
- benchbot / eng: publish csv + appendix (done)
- sam: webinar script + demo timing (Wed noon)
- priya: landing microcopy + two headlines (Wed EOD)
- jules: form routing & design coordination (Wed EOD)

ana: cool — I'll follow up tomorrow with a shortened one-pager for comms and the webinar runbook. :rocket:
